verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly show FIDO2 security keys and passkeys (hardware keys, native or third-party providers, and Microsoft Authenticator) can be registered and used to sign in to Entra. Conditional Access can require MFA for specific apps like Microsoft 365, and MFA and Conditional Access can be configured per application. However, nothing in the pack shows a policy that requires FIDO2 or passkeys specifically rather than generic MFA, and community reports of a downgrade attack against FIDO auth (where alternative methods remain) raise questions about how strictly it can be enforced. missing for 10: documented policy that requires FIDO2/passkeys specifically (not just any MFA) for sensitive apps, guidance on preventing fallback to weaker methods, independent hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
